observations: Photo 0 shows a pile of green corded drills, many with Bosch branding, in a cluttered workshop or storage area.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of several drills, including one with 'BOSCH' and 'BIT CORE PLUS' visible on the side.
The drills appear to be used, with visible wear, scratches, and some dirt.
No power cord or plug is clearly visible in either photo.
The drills are not shown connected to a power source or in operation.

claims.evidence: The brand 'Bosch' is visible in both photos, but the voltage (220v) and drill size (13mm) are not clearly readable on any label or body. The 'BIT CORE PLUS' text suggests a specific model, but no model number is visible.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The drill may not be 220v as claimed, or may not be compatible with Nigerian voltage.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the power plug and voltage rating label on the drill.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or lower voltage, which reduces value in Lagos market

risks.risk: The drill may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the drill in operation, or a close-up of the motor and internal components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which significantly reduces value

risks.risk: The drill may be missing essential parts (e.g., chuck, key, cord, or accessories).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full drill with all components included, including the chuck key and any accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the battery door or near the motor.
A clear photo of the power plug and voltage rating label on the drill.
A video clip showing the drill in operation.
A photo showing the full drill with all components included.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
